//exclude: Test files are excluded from the APP build because they are not app code and
are not compiled by this toolchain. They run under the ROOT vitest suite (see
vitest.config.ts), whose default include glob reaches dashboard/src, and
src/citations.test.ts imports the backend's real prompt builders on purpose --
a rule about EvidenceItem.source is only worth testing against the strings the
backend really emits. Compiling those imports HERE fails, and the reason is the
one src/derive.ts already records: this project runs a deliberate TypeScript
5.7 / 7 split, and the dashboard sets noUnusedLocals where the Worker does not
and declares no Workers types. That is a property of the two toolchains, not a
fault in either tree, and excluding a test file is the correct place to absorb
it -- widening the dashboard's options or editing backend source to satisfy a
dashboard build would both be worse.
